findings.title: Default strategy test skips enabling rolling-updates feature
findings.body: In createInitialDeployment() the method returns early when updateStrategy == null before the FeatureSpec with ROLLING_UPDATES is added (lines 105-106 vs 115). So the parameterized case with null strategy runs without the preview feature enabled, while the RECREATE case runs with it. Per the new docs the Operator will fail while on preview stage if rolling-updates is not enabled, so the null case will either fail or test a different code path than intended, and rolling behavior for the default strategy is not covered.

findings.title: Feature-disabled path only tested for metadata, without exit code
findings.body: testFeatureNotEnabled only launches update-compatibility metadata without --features and only asserts the error text. There is no equivalent test for the check subcommand which has the same gate in UpdateCompatibilityCheck.java, and neither test asserts the new exit code CompatibilityResult.FEATURE_DISABLED (4) defined in CompatibilityResult.java. A regression that prints the message but returns the wrong exit code (e.g. 0) or that breaks one subcommand would not be caught.
